summary: Iteration 4 — Frontend-only validation of AutoLenis light theme redesign, public pages, inventory flow, forms, and CSRF-exempt endpoints. All 10 public/auth pages render with white body backgrounds (rgb(255,255,255)), AutoLenis logo visible in nav, brand purple rgb(100,50,147)=#643293 accents confirmed, and ZERO console errors. Inventory shows 6 live DB vehicles, filter dropdown (Toyota) correctly narrows results. Vehicle detail page loads real DB data. Mobile hamburger menu opens/closes. All 4 public POST endpoints bypass CSRF successfully (201). No regressions found.

minor.issue: Schema requires tcpaConsent (boolean) as REQUIRED field — clients must include tcpaConsent:true. Not a bug, but should be documented for front-end form integration.
Schema required fields differ from first attempt: needs dealershipType, licenseNumber, contactName, contactEmail (not firstName/lastName/dealerLicenseNumber). Returns 201 with correct schema.

critical_code_review_comments: Dealer signin and Affiliate register use a two-panel layout where left panel has dark-purple brand hero (#643293) and right panel is white/light with the form. This is a brand-accent hero, not a dark theme regression — the BODY background is white and the rest of each page is light. Consistent with user's ask of 'lighter colors' with logo/brand accents.
Pricing and How-It-Works use a purple hero band at top (~400px) then transition to white content — consistent with a premium fintech light theme using brand color as accent.

Public form APIs (refinance, dealer-application) return VALIDATION_ERROR 400 when called with wrong schema. Front-end forms should match the exact schemas; main agent should verify the front-end forms submit tcpaConsent and correct dealer-application fields.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 pages render light theme with 0 console errors; nav, inventory, vehicle detail, filters, mobile menu all functional)

test_credentials: No auth required for public tests. Admin credentials available in review request but not used.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing 6 vehicles in DB (Tesla Model 3, Toyota Camry, Ford F-150, BMW 3 Series, Honda Accord, Chevrolet Silverado) continue to return via /api/public/inventory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light theme redesign validated end-to-end. All 10 public pages (/, /inventory, /inventory/[id], /for-buyers, /for-dealers, /for-affiliates, /pricing, /trust, /how-it-works, /dealer/signin, /affiliate/register) render correctly with white background + purple brand accents + AutoLenis logo. Inventory has 6 live vehicles, filters work, vehicle detail loads real DB data. Mobile responsive menu functional. Public CSRF-exempt APIs (feedback, contact, refinance, dealer-application) all return 201 without X-CSRF-Token header.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
